children: Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) reported record profits but warned Q3 FICC may trail equities and non‑comp expenses will rise by about $500M, even as it boosts asset & wealth management, raised $11.7B in private‑equity funds and expanded Alternatives AUM toward 2030 targets.
Previous Week Recap
FICC Slightly Weak Relative To Equities

: Goldman Sachs (GS): CEO David Solomon says FICC likely slightly weaker than equities in Q3. Firm warns of ~ $500M higher sequential non-comp expenses and less favorable revenue mix; shares fell ~4%.
Non-Comp Expense Rise Over $500M
: Goldman Sachs (GS) expects non-compensation operating expenses to rise by over $500M sequentially, driven by higher run‑the‑business costs versus the prior quarter.
GS Grabs ~25% Global IB Fees
: Goldman Sachs (GS) grabbed about 25% of global investment banking fees through Sept. 15, up from 19% for the full prior year, as deal activity concentrated into bigger, fewer transactions.
Asset & Wealth Growth, 30% Margin
: Goldman Sachs (GS) says its asset and wealth management arm is growing, targeting 30% operating margins and high‑teens returns for that segment.
Raised $11.7B Via Private-Equity Funds
: Goldman Sachs (GS) raised $11.7B via asset-management private-equity funds: $9.6B for West Street Capital Partners IX, $1.6B Asia strategy and $500M co-investments; deployment over ~4–4.5 years.
Shares Fall After Capital Raise
: Goldman Sachs (GS) shares dropped about 2.6% to $963.55 after the firm announced a capital raise. Intraday price reflects market reaction to the fundraising news.
Alternatives AUM Target $750B By 2030
: Goldman Sachs’ Alternatives unit managed $459B at June-end and aims for $750B AUM by 2030; it completed an $11.7B capital raise, about 2.5% of current AUM.
Trades Near 13x 2026 EPS $70
: Goldman Sachs (GS) trades near 13x projected 2026 EPS of $70 and about 2.5x book value, narrowing from a peak near 20x and aligning with big-bank peers.
Profits Cyclical Peak, Growth Slower
: Goldman Sachs (GS) strategist Ben Snider says current record profits are a cyclical peak, and GS expects earnings growth to slow in coming years rather than crash.
Anchor NSX Allocation At ₹1,785
: Goldman Sachs took an anchor allocation in the National Stock Exchange IPO at the Rs 1,785 offer price, participating in the Rs 6,746 crore anchor tranche.
